name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 03-structural-checks.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import json, re, sys
errs = []
def check(cond, msg):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + msg)
    if not cond: errs.append(msg)
s = json.load(open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1/schema-draft.json"))
check(s["draft_version"] == "0.2.0", "schema version 0.2.0")
check(s["status"] == "DRAFT / NOT EFFECTIVE", "status DRAFT/NOT EFFECTIVE")
check("contested" not in s["rater_handling_enum"], "contested not in rater enum")
check("contested" not in s["adjudication_handling_enum"], "contested not in adjudication enum")
check("either_defensible" in s["rater_handling_enum"] and "either_defensible" in s["adjudication_handling_enum"], "either_defensible in both enums")
f4 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F4")
check(any(c["field"] == "inapplicability_reason" and c["when"] == "value == not_applicable" for c in f4.get("requires_conditional", [])), "F4 conditional requires (R6)")
check("inapplicability_reason" not in f4.get("requires", []), "F4 no unconditional inapplicability reason (R6)")
f5 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F5")
slot = f5["structure"]["slot_schema"]
for k in ["reviewer_id", "exposure_declaration", "allowed_assistance", "restricted_capability", "clarification_sufficiency", "scoreable_view"]:
    check(k in slot, f"slot has {k}")
check("contested" in json.dumps(f5["structure"]["contested"]), "contested researcher-only block present")
f3 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F3")
check("criterion_id" in json.dumps(f3.get("criterion_ref", {})), "F3 criterion_ref targets criterion_id")
cols = ["A-DU","B-DU","C-DU","D-DU","A-AM","B-AM","C-AM","D-AM","A-NB","B-NB","C-NB","A-NH","B-NH","C-NH"]
rows = s["applicability"]["rows"]
check(len(rows) == 9, f"applicability rows == 9 (got {len(rows)})")
ok = all(all(c in r for c in cols) and set(r[c] for c in cols) <= {"applies","not_applies","conditional"} for r in rows)
check(ok, "applicability matrix complete with legal values")
check("no_D_arm_note" in s["applicability"], "no-D-arm note present")
pro = s["prohibitions"]
for p in ["no_contested_in_rater_or_adjudication_enums","no_automatic_contested_from_disagreement","no_confidence_derived_unscorable","no_role_as_identity","no_raw_slot_overwrite_by_adjudication","no_F1_F4_on_non_scorable_operational_outcomes","no_outcome_state_conversion_in_this_contract","no_composite_score"]:
    check(p in pro, f"prohibition {p}")
blob = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1/schema-draft.json").read()
for bad in ["probably_benign","probably_concerning","clearly_benign","clearly_concerning","BLIND-","RI-DU-","RI-AM-"]:
    check(bad not in blob, f"no human-label/corpus content {bad!r} in schema")
rub = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1/rubric-draft.md").read()
for term in ["criterion_id","exposure_declaration","scoreable_view","disagree","D-A","E5c"]:
    check(term in rub, f"rubric mentions {term}")
bc = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1/boundary-cases-r1.md").read()
for h in ["B-5R","B-2R","B-7R","B-8R"]:
    check(h in bc, f"boundary case {h} present")
print("STRUCTURAL:", "ALL PASS" if not errs else f"{len(errs)} FAILURES")
sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
PY

name: 04-e1b-untouched.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok = True
for line in open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b/run-outputs.sha256"):
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) != 2: continue
    exp, path = parts
    if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256"): continue
    if "logs/06-run-outputs" in path: continue
    try:
        got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print("MISSING", path); ok = False; continue
    status = "OK" if got == exp else "MODIFIED"
    if got != exp: ok = False
    print(status, path)
print("E1B-INTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY

command: bash -c git diff --check; echo "diff-check exit=$?"; git status --short | head -n 30; git diff -- .gitignore > docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1/delivery.diff; echo "---DELIVERY.DIFF---"; cat docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1/delivery.diff

name: 07-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r1\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"
